{{Top|leg}}
A '''pickle''' was a type of food.<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], pickles were among the food supplies [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Nyreen Vollen]] used as cover story for the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] that inspected her [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Cornucopia]]''. Unbeknownst to the stormtroopers, Vollen was hiding two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Kina Ha]] and [[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy]], aboard her ship.<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st" />

The [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] had a variety of pickles called [[swamp pickle]]s, which were despised by most [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]. The [[Kagles]], however, thoroughly enjoyed the pickles, and often purchased them from the [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Mooth]].
